The 17:30 weekday "Pod end of day" note for #strategic-pod is set up, and I've confirmed it in the channel thread.

Two things aren't working yet:
- The Hermes gateway isn't running, so the job won't fire until it's started.
- The scheduler is on the real clock, so the first run is Monday 26 Oct at 17:30 Chicago time, not later today. I set it to 22:30 UTC, so it will fire an hour late after US daylight saving ends in early November unless you want it changed.
